tut-starts-step1.detail: Tutorial 1 of 7 — Look around: Drag the ground to pan, or tap Zoom + to zoom in. Next tap: drag to pan, or tap a Zoom button.

tut-step1-look-via-zoom.detail: Tutorial 2 of 7 — Select a unit: Tap a blue unit to select it. Next tap: tap a blue unit.

tut-step3-move.detail: Tutorial 4 of 7 — Attack: Tap the pulsing red target to attack it. It cannot shoot back. Next tap: tap the red target.

tut-step4-attack.detail: Tutorial 5 of 7 — Build: Tap your Command Core, then tap Scout Buggy to build one. Next tap: tap your Command Core. (Tap the pulsing Command Core.)
